author: Th3MCN1nja
body:
For some reason, I cannot see any posts in this section, but I assume this is to where these are suppose to go, if not, well, I'm currently banned anyways, so what have you.
I'll try to keep this somewhat organized, since I can't seem to find a form we're suppose to use.

Username: Th3MCN1nja

Banned for: Kill Aura.
Time: August 26th 4:36:28 AM GMT.
Banned by: Junr

     As I can't find what the form, I don't know what evidence you require. I'll leave the evidence I need to prove I'm not hacking, up to you, so message me, reply to this, or whatever, just tell me what you want, no, I was not recording, so I don't have any video proof.
   As this appeal would be very short otherwise, I'll give some ideas as to what could've caused the Mod to believe I was using hacks.
 One: A small lag spike could've disrupted my movements on their screen, giving the appearance of instant head-snapping.
 1.5: A larger spike could've had the red damage indication from a different player and me happen at the same time. (I guess these two could be cancelled if the mod doesn't get lag spikes)
 Two: I haven't played since my old mouse, so of course, with my new mouse, the sensitivity can go much higher, allowing me to move much faster.
 Three: I don't know when the onlooking mod was watching, that's part of their job after all. But depending on where they were, terrain could've blocked proper sight.
 Four?: I don't like to say this, it makes me sound like a jerk, but I've been told that I'm great at PVP.

I really want to do a rage rant about this ban being stupid, but that probably wouldn't increase my standing. However, if you want something to make you chuckle, just tell me, I'll go and write a "W0w you souldn't haf banned me just 'cus ye' bad." type thing.

TL:DR: Tell me what I need to show you that can prove I didn't hack.
Anyways, I'll see you when you reply, hopefully.
